name: Recommendations
hides: Hides the suggested videos beside and below the video you're watching. Playlists, live chat, chapters and transcripts stay.

name: End screens
hides: Hides the grid of videos and the info cards that appear at the end of a video.

name: Autoplay off
hides: Turns YouTube's autoplay off, so the next video doesn't start by itself. The autoplay button still works, and playlists still play in order.

name: Comments
hides: Hides the comments below the video you're watching.
